description: This file handles AJAX requests for resetting/restoring various device settings, including rebooting, resetting Wi-Fi, factory reset, and user password management. It includes functions for Wi-Fi MAC filter management and processes different actions based on POST input, responding with JSON data.

methods.name: delMacFilterTable
methods.description: Deletes MAC filter entries for specified Wi-Fi SSIDs

methods.name: delMacFilterTables
methods.description: Deletes MAC filter entries for predefined SSIDs (1, 2, 3, 5, 6)
